notes.title: Version 1.0.1 Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Version 1.0.1 was just released,

the main goal of this patch is to fix the bug present in level 4-1
that prevented you from going back to the main map as
advancing to the next level.

it also correct 1 or 2 grammar mistake at the same time
(more correction to comes)

finally it allows the player to attack using the mouse
(left and right click and you should be able to
block with anyother button on your mouse)

If you run into anyother problems especially
regarding the linux and OSX build please post
them in the game's discussion or send me
and email at RoyalTeaTimeStudio@gmail.com

Also thanks to everyone who purchased the game
so far, we're off to a good start and thank you
for all the support.
